bearerAuth.description: JWT (dashboard sessions) or `furan_pat_*` (SDK/CI). Both arrive on `Authorization: Bearer ...`.

info.description: Visual regression testing API. See https://github.com/qasecret/furan-monorepo for self-host docs.
info.title: Furan API

schema.description: Anonymous SDK telemetry payload — server logs only, no validation.

post.summary: Anonymous SDK telemetry sink. Body is logged and discarded. Always returns 204.

200.description: Caller's tokens (raw token bytes never returned)

get.summary: List the caller's personal access tokens

token.description: Raw `furan_pat_*` token — shown ONCE, never retrievable again.

201.description: Token created; capture `token` field now (never retrievable again)

post.summary: Create a personal access token. Raw token is returned ONCE.

404.description: Token not found or not owned by caller

get.description: Long-lived response (`text/event-stream`). Connection closes when the client disconnects.

schema.description:
SSE frames in the format `event: progress
data: <JSON>

`. Keep-alive comments `:

` sent every 15s.

get.summary: Server-Sent Events stream for a run. Emits `event: progress` frames with JSON payloads carrying `{ event, runId, ...details }`. Sends a `:` keep-alive every 15s.

200.description: Image bytes. Content-Type is sniffed (image/png, image/webp, or image/jpeg).

404.description: Key not found, malformed, or storage backend error

get.summary: Authenticated proxy for stored image bytes. Key is sha256 hex of content (content-addressed storage).

post.summary: Authenticate with email + password; returns a JWT

200.description: Projects the caller has access to (admin: all; editor: member-of; guest: empty)

get.summary: List projects visible to the caller
Fetch a project by id (project members only)

200.description: Builds ordered by createdAt desc with cursor

get.summary: List builds for a project (paginated, with optional filters)

200.description: Existing build reattached (request properties merged in)

post.summary: Find-or-create a build under a project, keyed on (projectId, ciBuildId)

409.description: User is already a member of the project

post.summary: Add a member to a project (admin only)

delete.summary: Remove a member from a project (admin only)

503.description: At least one dependency is unreachable

get.summary: Readiness probe — checks Postgres, Redis, object storage

200.description: Run created (or upserted via test variation lookup)

400.description: Invalid body or build does not belong to the project

403.description: Not a project member with write access

domHtml.description: Optional captured DOM HTML, used by L2 diff.

name.description: Checkpoint name (required in v1.1+ shape; logged for traceability).

pngBytes.description: PNG screenshot bytes. Max 50 MB. Required.

200.description: Screenshot accepted; returns the stored record

400.description: Multipart parse failure, missing pngBytes, or other client error

403.description: Not a project member with write access

413.description: File part exceeded the 50 MB limit

post.summary: Upload a screenshot for a run. Multipart form with PNG bytes + optional DOM HTML. 50 MB max per file part.

patch.summary: Update a user (admin only). Cannot disable self.
